name: confirmed rows alone are drawn as they are, serials included
an unknown field and a row of an unknown type are kept; the unknown type is never visible
a pending update over a record the server deleted draws a record without life, which is not visible
a ready update joins over the confirmed row
a pending register older than the confirmed one loses the join
a newer pending value of lower rank loses to the confirmed higher rank
a held delete is drawn dead
an acked entry stays in the view until its result resolves
a command entry draws its prediction, and a later create draws without a serial
the newest pending text replaces the confirmed text; visibleWhen decides mark visibility
keyed puts draw link presence; a singleton is always visible
